system.description:
You coat your body in such a dense amount of Fire Release chakra that you emit a painfully bright Light. All creatures who can see within a 30-foot radius who don’t spend a reaction to avert their gaze or are behind total cover when this jutsu is cast must make a Constitution saving throw, being Blinded on a failed save for this jutsu’s duration.

Once your chakra calms after casting, your body becomes like living flame. You gain immunity against Wind, Fire, bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage and You gain vulnerability to Cold damage. When you would take Fire damage or suffer an effect cause by a jutsu with only the Fire release keyword, you instead regain hit points equal to half the amount of damage it would normally deal. If you enter water, you are surrounded by a 5-foot radius of steam and bubbles that grant you partial concealment but you also take 8d6 cold damage each round you remain in the water.
